p1.tell: The full quote says "no net increase" — the word "net" was removed, which changes the meaning because offsetting increases and decreases can still leave customers paying more in some months.
p1.explanation: The original quote from Ben Hertz-Shargel states "no net increase in electricity rates and a slight decrease in gas rates." The doctored post drops "net," turning a statement about the overall balance into a promise of no increase at all.
p1.con_line_fooled: One little word. That's all it took.
p1.con_line_caught: You read the whole sentence. How thorough. How annoying.
